title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Services - AdministrativeProcedure
description: Formal process followed by a public administration to manage, evaluate, and resolve a request, case, or administrative action (edintserpub:AdministrativeProcedure). NOTE: same tooling artifact as PublicService -- the source ontology's own class declaration uses a malformed IRI (owlapi/turtle# namespace); this entity uses the real servicios-publicos# IRI confirmed by the property domains and the source's own real example data.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AdministrativeProcedure'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

typeProcedure.description: Property. The type or category that classifies the procedure according to its processing characteristics, from the AdministrativeProcedureType controlled vocabulary (edintserpub:typeProcedure).

resolutionPeriod.description: Property. The expected or established period of time required to resolve the procedure, as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P3M' (edintserpub:resolutionPeriod).

stateProcedure.description: Property. The current state of the resolution process -- e.g. not started, in progress, resolved, closed (edintserpub:stateProcedure). The source ontology does not constrain this to a controlled vocabulary; kept as an open string, matching the real example's own free-text value ('Abierto').
